books.title: 哈利·波特与魔法石
books.titleEn: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
books.author: J.K. 罗琳
books.intro: 以少年眼中的魔法世界为舞台，擅长用灯光、气味、声音和夸张的身体细节，把奇幻场景写得像电影镜头一样可感可见。
books.introEn: Set in a magical world seen through a boy's eyes, these pages use light, scent, sound and exaggerated physical detail to make every fantasy scene feel like a film shot.

lessons.title: 用身体细节写一个人
lessons.scene: 清晨的四号普里怀特街，德思礼先生站在门前，准备开始普通得不能再普通的一天。
lessons.sceneEn: Early morning at number four, Privet Drive, as Mr Dursley gets ready for a perfectly ordinary day.
lessons.source: Chapter 1 · The Boy Who Lived
lessons.tell: Mr Dursley was large and had a big moustache.
lessons.show: He was a big, beefy man with hardly any neck, although he did have a very large moustache.
lessons.translation: 他是个高大壮实、几乎没有脖子的男人，不过他的胡子倒是非常大。
techniques: 用“几乎没有脖子”这种夸张的尺寸代替“胖”这个笼统的词
用“非常浓密的胡子”补充细节，让身体成为可想象的画面
不直接写性格，让读者从体型和胡子里自己推断
techniquesEn: Use an exaggerated size detail like 'hardly any neck' instead of the vague word 'fat'.
Add a vivid detail such as 'a very large moustache' so the body becomes a picture you can imagine.
Don't state his personality; let readers infer it from the build and the moustache.

lessons.title: 让巨人破门而入
lessons.scene: 暴风雨夜的海边小屋，门被猛地撞开，一个巨人挤进屋里。
lessons.sceneEn: A stormy night in a hut by the sea, as the door is smashed open and a giant squeezes inside.
lessons.source: Chapter 4 · The Keeper of the Keys
lessons.tell: A huge man appeared in the doorway. His face was hairy and his eyes were dark.
lessons.show: A giant of a man was standing in the doorway. His face was almost completely hidden by a long, shaggy mane of hair and a wild, tangled beard, but you could make out his eyes, glinting like black beetles under all the hair.
lessons.translation: 一个巨人般的男人站在门口。他的脸几乎完全被一头又长又乱蓬蓬的头发和一把野性缠结的大胡子遮住，只有那双眼睛还露在外面，像黑色甲虫一样在毛发下闪闪发光。
techniques: 先写整体：巨人般的男人
用“黑色甲虫”比喻眼睛，在浓密毛发中给读者一个亮点
先用头发和胡子遮住脸，再让眼睛露出来，制造发现感
techniquesEn: Start with the whole: 'a giant of a man'.
Compare the eyes to 'black beetles' so one bright detail stands out through the thick hair.
Hide the face in hair and beard first, then reveal the eyes for a sense of discovery.

lessons.title: 写第一次看见新世界
lessons.titleEn: Seeing a New World for the First Time
lessons.scene: 哈利第一次走进魔法世界的商业街，眼睛不知道该往哪里看。
lessons.sceneEn: Harry's first walk down a wizard shopping street, overwhelmed by everything there is to see.
lessons.source: Chapter 5 · Diagon Alley
lessons.tell: Harry was amazed by the magical street and looked at all the shops and people.
lessons.show: Harry wished he had about eight more eyes. He turned his head in every direction as they walked up the street, trying to look at everything at once: the shops, the things outside them, the people doing their shopping.
lessons.translation: 哈利真希望自己能再多出大约八只眼睛。他一边沿街走，一边把脑袋转向四面八方，想一下子看遍所有东西：那些店铺、店铺外摆着的东西，还有正在购物的人们。
techniques: 用“再多八只眼睛”的愿望表达惊叹，而不是写“他很惊讶”
用一连串具体名词铺开街道：店铺、货物、购物的人
用“把头转向四面八方”的动作呈现目不暇接
techniquesEn: Express wonder through the wish for 'about eight more eyes' instead of writing 'he was amazed'.
Spread the street out with concrete nouns: the shops, the things outside them, the people shopping.
Show the overwhelm through the action of turning his head in every direction.

lessons.title: 把城堡放在星光里
lessons.scene: 夜晚的黑湖上，小船向对岸驶去，霍格沃茨第一次出现在哈利眼前。
lessons.sceneEn: On the Black Lake at night, the boats row toward the shore as Hogwarts first appears.
lessons.source: Chapter 6 · The Journey from Platform Nine and Three-Quarters
lessons.tell: There was a big castle on a mountain across the lake.
lessons.show: Perched atop a high mountain on the other side, its windows sparkling in the starry sky, was a vast castle with many turrets and towers.
lessons.translation: 湖对岸高山的顶上，矗立着一座巨大的城堡，许多塔楼和尖塔在缀满星星的夜空里，窗子闪闪发光。
techniques: 把最重要的名词放到句尾，先吊起悬念再揭晓城堡
用“窗子在星空下闪闪发光”这一处细节让远景活起来
用“塔楼和尖塔”这种具体建筑词汇代替“很大很壮观”
techniquesEn: Save the key noun for the end of the sentence, building suspense before revealing the castle.
Bring a distant scene to life with one detail: windows sparkling in the starry sky.
Use specific architecture words like 'turrets and towers' instead of 'big and impressive'.

lessons.title: 成千上万支漂浮的蜡烛
lessons.scene: 开学宴会的夜晚，一年级新生走进点满蜡烛的大礼堂。
lessons.sceneEn: On the night of the start-of-term feast, the first-years enter the candlelit Great Hall.
lessons.source: Chapter 7 · The Sorting Hat
lessons.tell: The Great Hall was bright and full of students sitting at long tables.
lessons.show: It was lit by thousands and thousands of candles which were floating in mid-air over four long tables, where the rest of the students were sitting. These tables were laid with glittering golden plates and goblets.
lessons.translation: 成千上万支蜡烛在半空中漂浮，照亮四张长长的桌子，其他学生正坐在桌旁。桌上摆满了闪闪发光的金色盘子和高脚杯。
techniques: 重复“成千上万”强调数量和气势
让蜡烛在半空中漂浮，制造魔法世界独有的画面
用“闪闪发光的金色盘子”叠加材质、颜色和反光
techniquesEn: Repeat 'thousands and thousands' to emphasize scale and grandeur.
Set the candles floating in mid-air to create an image unique to the magical world.
Layer material, colour and reflection with 'glittering golden plates'.

lessons.title: 让帽子开口说话
lessons.scene: 分院仪式开始，破旧的分院帽在所有人面前突然动了。
lessons.sceneEn: At the Sorting, the battered Sorting Hat suddenly moves in front of the whole school.
lessons.source: Chapter 7 · The Sorting Hat
lessons.tell: Then the hat started to sing.
lessons.show: A rip near the brim opened wide like a mouth – and the hat began to sing:
lessons.translation: 帽檐附近的一道裂缝像嘴巴一样张得大大的——帽子开始唱歌了。
techniques: 把一个旧物件写活：先是帽子抽动，再是裂缝张开
用“像嘴巴一样”的比喻让裂缝有表情
用破折号停顿，再揭晓帽子开始唱歌，制造惊喜
techniquesEn: Bring an old object to life: first the hat twitches, then the rip opens.
Use the simile 'like a mouth' to give the rip an expressive face.
Pause with a dash, then reveal that the hat begins to sing for a surprise.

lessons.title: 给怪物加上层层比喻
lessons.titleEn: Layers of Similes for a Monster
lessons.scene: 万圣节之夜，哈利和罗恩在女生盥洗室撞见一头巨怪。
lessons.sceneEn: On Hallowe'en, Harry and Ron come face to face with a troll in the girls' bathroom.
lessons.source: Chapter 10 · Hallowe'en
lessons.tell: The troll was huge, grey and very ugly.
lessons.show: Twelve feet tall, its skin was a dull, granite grey, its great lumpy body like a boulder with its small bald head perched on top like a coconut. It had short legs thick as tree trunks with flat, horny feet.
lessons.translation: 它有十二英尺高，皮肤是灰蒙蒙的花岗岩色，庞大的块状身体像一块巨石，小小的秃头像椰子一样搁在顶上。它的两条短腿粗得像树干，脚掌又平又硬。
techniques: 先给一个精确数字“十二英尺高”，建立体积感
连续使用比喻：身体像巨石、头像椰子、腿像树干
用颜色和材质“花岗岩灰”让皮肤真实可感
techniquesEn: Open with an exact number, 'twelve feet tall', to establish scale.
Stack similes: body like a boulder, head like a coconut, legs like tree trunks.
Use colour and material, 'granite grey', to make the skin feel real.

lessons.title: 小球也要有翅膀和颜色
lessons.titleEn: A Small Ball with Wings and Colour
lessons.scene: 魁地奇训练前的傍晚，伍德打开箱子向哈利介绍四种球。
lessons.sceneEn: Before Quidditch training, Oliver Wood opens the crate and introduces the four balls.
lessons.source: Chapter 11 · Quidditch
lessons.tell: The Golden Snitch was a small gold ball with wings.
lessons.show: Compared with the Quaffle and the Bludgers, it was tiny, about the size of a large walnut. It was bright gold and had little fluttering silver wings.
lessons.translation: 跟鬼飞球和游走球比起来，它小极了，大约只有一颗大核桃那么大。它通体亮金色，还长着两只不停扇动的银色小翅膀。
techniques: 用“大核桃”这种熟悉物品让读者立刻知道大小
用“亮金色”和“银色小翅膀”制造颜色对比
用“扑闪着”写出小东西的轻快与动态
techniquesEn: Compare it to a familiar object, 'a large walnut', so readers instantly know the size.
Contrast the 'bright gold' with the 'little fluttering silver wings'.
Use fluttering to show the small object's lightness and motion.

lessons.title: 用动作写渴望
lessons.scene: 深夜，哈利独自站在厄里斯魔镜前，第一次看见自己的父母。
lessons.sceneEn: Late at night, Harry stands alone before the Mirror of Erised and sees his parents for the first time.
lessons.source: Chapter 12 · The Mirror of Erised
lessons.tell: Harry looked at his family in the mirror and wished he could reach them.
lessons.show: The Potters smiled and waved at Harry and he stared hungrily back at them, his hands pressed flat against the glass as though he was hoping to fall right through it and reach them.
lessons.translation: 波特夫妇朝哈利微笑、挥手，哈利则饥渴地盯着他们，双手平贴在镜面上，仿佛希望自己能直接穿过玻璃，来到他们身边。
techniques: 用“贪婪地盯着”和“双手平贴玻璃”表达强烈渴望
用“希望穿过玻璃去拥抱他们”的想象把愿望外化
不写“他很想家人”，全部用身体动作呈现
techniquesEn: Show fierce longing through 'stared hungrily' and hands pressed flat against the glass.
Externalize the wish through the image of hoping to fall right through the glass.
Never write 'he missed them'; convey it entirely through physical action.

lessons.title: 用光写恐怖
lessons.scene: 禁林深处，月光断续照亮地上独角兽的血迹。
lessons.sceneEn: Deep in the Forbidden Forest, moonlight picks out the trail of unicorn blood.
lessons.source: Chapter 15 · The Forbidden Forest
lessons.tell: They could see drops of blood on the ground in the dark forest.
lessons.show: Every now and then a ray of moonlight through the branches above lit a spot of silver blue blood on the fallen leaves.
lessons.translation: 时不时地，一束月光穿过头顶的枝叶，照亮落叶上的一点银蓝色血迹。
techniques: 用月光作为光源，只在光照到的地方揭示细节
用“银蓝色的血”这个不寻常的颜色制造诡异美
让恐怖的线索与安静的画面形成反差
techniquesEn: Use moonlight as the light source, revealing detail only where the light falls.
Choose an unusual colour, 'silver blue blood', for an eerie beauty.
Let the frightening clue contrast with the stillness of the scene.

lessons.title: 让奖品在黑暗中闪光
lessons.scene: 深夜潜入奖杯室的路上，月光穿过高窗洒进走廊。
lessons.sceneEn: On the way to the trophy room at night, moonlight streams through the high windows.
lessons.source: Chapter 9 · The Midnight Duel
lessons.tell: The trophy room looked impressive in the moonlight.
lessons.show: The crystal trophy cases glimmered where the moonlight caught them. Cups, shields, plates and statues winked silver and gold in the darkness.
lessons.translation: 水晶奖杯陈列柜在月光照到的地方微微闪光。奖杯、盾牌、盘子和雕像在黑暗中闪着银光和金光。
techniques: 用“月光照到的地方”引导读者的视线
用“闪烁”和“眨眼睛”给无生命的奖杯赋予动态
用银与金的颜色对比照亮黑暗的房间
techniquesEn: Guide the reader's eye with 'where the moonlight caught them'.
Use 'glimmered' and 'winked' to give lifeless trophies movement.
Light the dark room with the contrast of silver and gold.

lessons.title: 用比例写一只小龙
lessons.scene: 海格的小屋里，龙蛋裂开，小诺伯摔到桌上。
lessons.sceneEn: In Hagrid's hut, the dragon egg cracks open and baby Norbert lands on the table.
lessons.source: Chapter 14 · Norbert the Norwegian Ridgeback
lessons.tell: The baby dragon looked strange and was mostly wings.
lessons.show: Its spiny wings were huge compared to its skinny jet body and it had a long snout with wide nostrils, stubs of horns and bulging, orange eyes.
lessons.translation: 它那多刺的翅膀和细瘦的乌黑身体比起来大得不成比例，长长的口鼻上张着宽大的鼻孔，还长着短短的犄角和鼓鼓的橙色眼睛。
techniques: 用“和细瘦的乌黑身体相比，翅膀大得不成比例”突出特征
用具体器官清单让怪物可信：口鼻、鼻孔、犄角、眼睛
用颜色“橙色眼睛”和“乌黑身体”制造鲜明对比
techniquesEn: Emphasize the feature through proportion: wings huge compared to the skinny jet body.
Make the creature believable with a concrete list: snout, nostrils, horns, eyes.
Contrast the 'orange eyes' with the 'jet body'.

books.title: 老人与海
books.titleEn: The Old Man and the Sea
books.author: 欧内斯特·海明威
books.intro: 用克制的短句和精确的动作写海上的孤独与搏斗，光线、颜色、声音都成为人物内心最忠实的翻译。
books.introEn: With restrained short sentences and exact physical action, it translates an old fisherman's solitude and struggle through light, colour and sound.

lessons.title: 补丁帆与失败的旗帜
lessons.titleEn: A Patched Sail and the Flag of Defeat
lessons.scene: 港口边，老人把小船拉上岸，男孩来帮他收起补丁累累的船帆。
lessons.sceneEn: By the harbour, the old man hauls his skiff ashore and the boy helps him furl the patched sail.
lessons.source: Opening · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: The sail was old and patched.
lessons.show: The sail was patched with flour sacks and, furled, it looked like the flag of permanent defeat.
lessons.translation: 船帆是用面粉袋补起来的，卷起时看上去就像一面宣告永久失败的旗帜。
techniques: 用补丁、面粉袋这些具体物件代替“穷”
把卷起的船帆比作失败的旗帜，让物件承载象征
用“永久的失败”制造反差，反而突出人物不认输
techniquesEn: Use concrete objects such as patches and flour sacks instead of saying 'poor'.
Compare the furled sail to a flag of defeat so the object carries symbolism.
Let the phrase 'permanent defeat' create contrast, highlighting the old man's refusal to give up.

lessons.title: 眼睛和大海同色
lessons.titleEn: Eyes the Colour of the Sea
lessons.scene: 码头上，老渔夫们远远看着他，男孩把缆绳递到他手里。
lessons.sceneEn: On the docks, the older fishermen watch from a distance as the boy hands the old man the line.
lessons.source: Opening · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: The old man looked old except for his bright eyes.
lessons.show: Everything about him was old except his eyes and they were the same color as the sea and were cheerful and undefeated.
lessons.translation: 他身上的一切都老了，只有眼睛除外；那双眼睛和大海同色，快乐而永不认输。
techniques: 用“除了眼睛”的排除法把视线集中到一个部位
让眼睛与大海同色，把人物融入环境
用“快乐而不认输”收束，但前面全是画面
techniquesEn: Use 'except' to focus all attention on one part of the body.
Make the eyes the same colour as the sea so the character merges with his world.
Close with 'cheerful and undefeated', but build the image first.

lessons.title: 希望像微风一样清新
lessons.scene: 清晨的露台上，男孩送来咖啡和饵料，老人答应再次出海。
lessons.sceneEn: Early morning on the Terrace, as the boy brings coffee and bait and the old man agrees to fish again.
lessons.source: Opening · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: He felt more hopeful and confident.
lessons.show: His hope and his confidence had never gone. But now they were freshening as when the breeze rises.
lessons.translation: 他的希望和信心从来没有消失过。可现在，它们正在变得清新，就像微风刚刚吹起。
techniques: 把希望和信心当作可以被“变得清新”的事物来写
用“微风升起”这一自然现象比喻内心变化
不直接写“他振作起来”，而是写感受的变化
techniquesEn: Treat hope and confidence as things that can 'freshen'.
Compare inner change to a breeze rising.
Instead of saying 'he felt better', describe the change in feeling.

lessons.title: 薄薄升起的太阳
lessons.scene: 黎明的大海上，老人划船离开海岸，太阳刚从海面升起。
lessons.sceneEn: At dawn on the Gulf Stream, the old man rows away from shore as the sun rises.
lessons.source: The Gulf Stream · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: The sun came up and he could see the other boats.
lessons.show: The sun rose thinly from the sea and the old man could see the other boats, low on the water and well in toward the shore, spread out across the current.
lessons.translation: 太阳薄薄地从海面上升起，老人能看见其他渔船低低地浮在水上，整齐地散布在海流中，靠近海岸。
techniques: 用“薄薄地”修饰日出，写出清晨的光线质感
用低矮的船、靠近海岸、散布在海流中交代空间关系
从光源写到景物，建立清晰的视觉顺序
techniquesEn: Use 'thinly' to give the sunrise a specific texture of early light.
Place the boats low on the water, near the shore, spread across the current.
Move from the light source to the scene for a clear visual order.

lessons.title: 深到几乎发紫的海
lessons.titleEn: Water So Dark It Was Almost Purple
lessons.scene: 远海上，老人低头看着深蓝的海水，鱼线笔直垂向黑暗。
lessons.sceneEn: Far out at sea, the old man looks down into the dark blue water where his lines hang straight.
lessons.source: The Gulf Stream · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: The sea was very dark blue.
lessons.show: The water was a dark blue now, so dark that it was almost purple. As he looked down into it he saw the red sifting of the plankton in the dark water and the strange light the sun made now.
lessons.translation: 海水现在是深蓝色的，深得几乎发紫。他低头看下去，看见暗色海水里红色的浮游生物在筛落，还有太阳此刻在水面造出的奇异光。
techniques: 用“深得几乎发紫”让颜色有渐变和边界
把视线带进水下：红色浮游生物、奇异的光
一个颜色细节就能暗示船已进入远海
techniquesEn: Push the colour to a boundary with 'so dark that it was almost purple'.
Take the eye below the surface: the red plankton and the strange light.
Let one colour detail suggest how far out to sea the boat has gone.

lessons.title: 远山像覆雪的峰
lessons.scene: 海岸已经消失，老人眼前只剩下蓝色远山与云。
lessons.sceneEn: The coast has vanished; only the blue hills and the clouds remain.
lessons.source: The Gulf Stream · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: He was too far out to see the shore, only hills and clouds.
lessons.show: He could not see the green of the shore now but only the tops of the blue hills that showed white as though they were snow-capped and the clouds that looked like high snow mountains above them.
lessons.translation: 他已经看不见岸上的绿色，只能看见蓝色山丘的顶部，它们泛着白，仿佛覆盖着雪；云朵在它们上方，看起来像高耸的雪山。
techniques: 用“看不见”反写距离，比“很远”更有画面
让蓝色的山显出白色，像覆了雪
把云比作更高的雪山，层层向上延伸
techniquesEn: Show distance through what he can no longer see.
Let the blue hills show white 'as though they were snow-capped'.
Compare the clouds to high snow mountains so the view climbs upward.

lessons.title: 带着死亡活过来的鱼
lessons.titleEn: A Fish Alive with His Death in Him
lessons.scene: 大海上，大鱼跃出水面，老人第一次看清它的全部。
lessons.sceneEn: On the sea, the great fish leaps and the old man sees all of it for the first time.
lessons.source: The Marlin · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: The fish jumped out of the water and fell back.
lessons.show: Then the fish came alive, with his death in him, and rose high out of the water showing all his great length and width and all his power and his beauty. He seemed to hang in the air above the old man in the skiff.
lessons.translation: 接着，大鱼带着体内的死亡活了过来，高高跃出水面，显出它全部的长度和宽度，以及它全部的力量和美。它仿佛悬在小船上空，悬在老人头顶。
techniques: 用“带着死亡活了过来”制造矛盾与张力
同时展示长度、宽度、力量与美，让大鱼完整出现
用“悬在空中”放慢高潮，让读者停留在这幅画里
techniquesEn: Create tension with 'with his death in him' and 'came alive'.
Show length, width, power and beauty together so the whole fish appears.
Slow the climax with 'seemed to hang in the air' so the image lingers.

lessons.title: 从血的暗云中升起
lessons.titleEn: Rising from the Dark Cloud of Blood
lessons.scene: 大海上，鲨鱼循着血迹从深水中升起。
lessons.sceneEn: At sea, a shark rises from the deep, drawn by the spreading blood.
lessons.source: The Sharks · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: A shark appeared because it smelled the blood.
lessons.show: The shark was not an accident. He had come up from deep down in the water as the dark cloud of blood had settled and dispersed in the mile deep sea. He had come up so fast and absolutely without caution that he broke the surface of the blue water and was in the sun.
lessons.translation: 这条鲨鱼不是偶然出现的。它从深水中升上来，那时血的暗云已经在深达一英里的海里沉淀、散开。它上来得那么快，那么毫无顾忌，一下冲破蓝色海面，暴露在阳光里。
techniques: 用“不是偶然”把鲨鱼出现写成必然
用“血的暗云在深海里沉淀、散开”代替“闻到血腥味”
用“毫无顾忌地冲破海面”写出凶残
techniquesEn: Open with 'was not an accident' to make the arrival feel inevitable.
Replace 'smelled blood' with the dark cloud settling and dispersing in the mile deep sea.
Show ferocity through the action of breaking the surface 'without caution'.

lessons.title: 像快艇一样犁过水面
lessons.titleEn: Plowing Over the Water Like a Speedboat
lessons.scene: 被刺中的鲨鱼在绳圈中翻滚挣扎，海水被搅得雪白。
lessons.sceneEn: The wounded shark rolls and thrashes in the rope, churning the water white.
lessons.source: The Sharks · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: The dying shark moved quickly across the water.
lessons.show: Then, on his back, with his tail lashing and his jaws clicking, the shark plowed over the water as a speedboat does. The water was white where his tail beat it and three-quarters of his body was clear above the water when the rope came taut, shivered, and then snapped.
lessons.translation: 接着，它翻过身来，尾巴抽打，下颌咔嗒作响，像快艇一样犁过水面。尾巴拍击的地方，海水被搅得雪白，它四分之三的身体高高露出水面，直到绳索绷紧、颤抖，然后啪地断开。
techniques: 用“像快艇一样”把海上的挣扎拉到读者熟悉的画面
“尾巴抽打”和“下颌咔嗒作响”写出声音与动作
用“水被搅白”让海水替鲨鱼展示力量
techniquesEn: Bridge the unfamiliar sea struggle to a familiar image with 'as a speedboat does'.
Use 'tail lashing' and 'jaws clicking' for sound and motion.
Let the white water show the shark's power.

lessons.title: 用声音写黑暗
lessons.scene: 黎明前的黑暗里，老人划着船，听见飞鱼拍翅离去。
lessons.sceneEn: Before dawn, the old man rows in darkness and hears flying fish take off.
lessons.source: Before Dawn · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: The old man heard flying fish in the dark.
lessons.show: In the dark the old man could feel the morning coming and as he rowed he heard the trembling sound as flying fish left the water and the hissing that their stiff set wings made as they soared away in the darkness.
lessons.translation: 黑暗里，老人能感觉到清晨正在来临；他一边划船，一边听见飞鱼离开水面时颤抖的声响，以及它们僵硬的翅膀在黑暗中滑翔而过时的嘶嘶声。
techniques: 在完全黑暗里用声音写看不见的飞鱼
“颤抖的声响”与“嘶嘶声”形成听觉层次
让“早晨正在来临”成为可以感受的过程
techniquesEn: Describe invisible flying fish through sound in the dark.
Layer the 'trembling sound' and the 'hissing' of stiff wings.
Make morning itself something he can feel arriving.

lessons.title: 遥远的朋友：星星
lessons.scene: 夜晚的海上，老人靠在船头，望着第一批星星。
lessons.sceneEn: At night at sea, the old man rests against the bow and watches the first stars.
lessons.source: The Night at Sea · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: It was dark, and he rested under the stars.
lessons.show: It was dark now as it becomes dark quickly after the sun sets in September. He lay against the worn wood of the bow and rested all that he could. The first stars were out. He did not know the name of Rigel but he saw it and knew soon they would all be out and he would have all his distant friends.
lessons.translation: 现在天已经黑了，就像九月里太阳落山后很快就黑下来一样。他靠在船头磨损的木板上，尽力休息。第一批星星出现了。他不知道那颗星叫参宿七，但他看见了它，知道很快所有星星都会出来，他就又会有他那些遥远的朋友。
techniques: 用“九月天黑得很快”交代时间与氛围
“磨损的船头木板”让孤独有触感
把星星称作“遥远的朋友”，把情感放进比喻
techniquesEn: Use 'dark quickly after the sun sets in September' to set time and mood.
Ground the loneliness in the worn wood of the bow.
Call the stars 'distant friends' so the emotion lives in a metaphor.

lessons.title: 海龟的铠甲与水母
lessons.scene: 海上白日，老人一边守线，一边想起海龟吃水母的样子。
lessons.sceneEn: By day at sea, the old man minds his lines and remembers how the turtles eat the jellyfish.
lessons.source: The Gulf Stream · The Old Man and the Sea
lessons.tell: He loved the elegant turtles and disliked the big slow ones.
lessons.show: He loved green turtles and hawk-bills with their elegance and speed and their great value and he had a friendly contempt for the huge, stupid loggerheads, yellow in their armour-plating, strange in their love-making, and happily eating the Portuguese men-of-war with their eyes shut.
lessons.translation: 他喜爱绿海龟和玳瑁，喜爱它们的优雅、速度和巨大价值；他对那些又大又蠢的蠵龟则怀有一种友善的轻蔑：它们披着黄色的铠甲，求爱方式古怪，还会闭着眼睛高高兴兴地吃葡萄牙僧帽水母。
techniques: 用“优雅”“速度”“价值”并列，写出喜爱
给蠵龟配上一串意外细节：黄色铠甲、古怪求爱、闭眼吃水母
用“友善的轻蔑”这种矛盾词组塑造老人的态度
techniquesEn: List 'elegance', 'speed' and 'great value' to show affection.
Give the loggerheads surprising details: yellow armour, strange love-making, eating with shut eyes.
Use the contradictory phrase 'friendly contempt' to shape the old man's attitude.
